<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX202024-09-1811-03-22" status="unreviewed" ana="corpusmd:colophon"> 
               chen po rnams kyi zhabs kyi rdul spyi por blangs ste | 
               mang du thos pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol du phyin pa'i don dang | 
               mdo dang dgongs 'gro ba mdzad pa'i gzhung lugs sangs che ba 'thong pa'i don la yangs pa  <lb n="208a3"/>las byung pa'i shes rab kyis || 
               legs par bstan la phabs pa'i don zab pa pa dang rgya che ba bston par byed pa 'di || 
               lung dang rigs pa'i don la dbang phyug du rgyur pa || | 
               <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db.4018">shakya'i dge slong rtsang chu mig pa sang ge <note type="gloss">dpal</note> bzang po</rs> <note type="gloss">gyis</note> <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6173">gsang phu ne'u thog gi gtsug khang</rs> du legs par sbyar pa'o ||</seg></TEI>
